info.name: Apifreaks Api Hub For Developers WHOIS APIs API
Retrieve WHOIS registration data, CIDR block inventory, and BGP peer relationships for an Autonomous System Number

params.name: asn
params.description: Autonomous System Number to retrieve WHOIS data for, with or without the 'AS' prefix (e.g. 15169 or AS15169).

items.docs: Returns the WHOIS record for the specified ASN, including organization details, IPv4/IPv6 route objects, upstream/downstream/peer relationships, and both parsed and raw WHOIS text. Accepts the ASN with or without the 'AS' prefix.

info.name: Retrieve real-time WHOIS registration and ownership data for a domain name

params.name: domainName
params.description: Domain name to retrieve WHOIS data for (e.g. example.com).

items.docs: Returns the current WHOIS record for the specified domain, including registrar details, registrant/administrative/technical/billing/reseller contacts, name servers, status codes, and raw WHOIS text.

info.name: Retrieve real-time WHOIS registration and ownership data for up to 100 domain names in a single request

items.docs: Returns the current WHOIS record for each requested domain, in request order. Supports up to 100 domain names per request; a domain that fails to resolve yields an error item instead of failing the whole batch.

info.name: Retrieve the complete historical WHOIS record timeline for a domain name

params.name: domainName
params.description: Domain name to retrieve historical WHOIS records for (e.g. example.com).

items.docs: Returns every recorded WHOIS snapshot for the specified domain in chronological order, including registrar, contact, name server, and status changes over time.

info.name: Search domains by owner name, email, company, or keyword

params.name: keyword
params.description: Keyword to search for in domain names (case-insensitive pattern matching).

params.name: email
params.description: Email address to search for in registrant records (case-insensitive exact or regex match; * wildcard supported).

params.name: owner
params.description: Registrant or owner name to search for (full-text phrase matching).

params.name: company
params.description: Organization or company name to search for (full-text phrase matching).

params.name: exact
params.description: Set to true to return only exact matches for keyword, owner, or company. Default is false.

params.name: mode
params.description: Response detail level. 'default' returns full WHOIS data per domain; 'mini' returns only key fields.

items.docs: Performs a reverse WHOIS search returning matching domains with registration details. Use mode=default for full WHOIS data or mode=mini for a condensed summary. When mode=default, each item in whois_domains_historical matches the ReverseWhoisDomainDefault schema (full registrar, contacts, name servers, status, and registry data). When mode=mini, each item matches the ReverseWhoisDomainMini schema (domain name, create/update/expiry dates, owner name, email, and company only).

info.name: Retrieve WHOIS registration and ownership data for an IP address

params.name: ip
params.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up.

items.docs: Returns WHOIS details for an IPv4 or IPv6 address including IP range, organization, contacts, routes, and raw WHOIS output.
